topics.label: Introduction and learning outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: These remarks introduce the cancer biology course series and outline the specific learning outcomes for the lecture.

topics.label: Biological mechanisms of cancer and tissue organization
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how genetic alterations disrupt differentiation and three-dimensional tissue architecture, and consider the experimental challenges of modelling this architecture in vitro.

topics.label: Pathology of tumor invasion and metastasis
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain the concepts of local invasion and metastatic dissemination and illustrate the histological differences between encapsulated benign tumors and invasive malignancies.

topics.label: Stepwise progression and clinical risks of benign neoplasms
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe the stepwise transition from benign precursor polyps to invasive colorectal adenocarcinoma and examine the local hazards posed by non-malignant tumors.

topics.label: Neoplasm nomenclature and classification
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic defines the systematic naming conventions and clinical exceptions used to classify benign and malignant neoplasms across diverse tissue lineages.

topics.label: Mechanisms of cancer morbidity and mortality
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic explains the anatomical and physiological mechanisms through which localized tumor growth and widespread metastatic colonization cause illness and death.

topics.label: Cancer incidence across humans and animal species
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics analyse the epidemiological distribution of major cancer types in humans and compare tumor incidence across diverse multicellular animal taxa.

topics.label: Clinical presentation and cancer screening methods
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics address the clinical signs of cancer and assess the efficacy and limitations of screening programs for major tumor types.

topics.label: Concluding remarks and practical arrangements
topics.groupedBecause: These closing remarks recap the core learning outcomes and provide housekeeping details for upcoming practical sessions and lectures.
